description: The quotient-plus-default carrier of a finite retained term set \(S\) has at most \(|S|+1\) elements.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.carrier_card_bound.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (hE : E ⊆ S.product S) :
  Nat.card (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.Carrier S E hE) ≤ S.card + 1
